hosts.text: As born and raised locals we know our city, and we love sharing it. We still discover romantic places, tasty restaurants and cosy pubs — and we'll gladly advise you on cycling and walking tours in and around the city, to the sea, through the polders, or a romantic evening stroll.
hosts.title: Born and raised in Bruges

house.text: Guests have their own room and bathroom. Breakfast is served in the dining room or outside in our sunny, flowered garden. Our chickens don't like other pets — only our dear dog, and he loves our guests. Smoking is allowed in the garden.
house.title: Your own room, our sunny garden

neighbourhood.text: Our three guestrooms sit in the quiet and green Saint Ann district, a popular working-class area within the old city walls. A ten-minute walk along picturesque small streets brings you to the city centre — historic buildings, museums, festivals and exhibitions. Three kilometres further, on foot or by bike, the green surroundings of the city stretch all the way to the sea.
neighbourhood.title: Quiet, green Saint Ann
